name: Do I need permits for living room trip hazard removal in Pacifica or Daly City?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for living room trip hazard removal in Pacifica or Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: For basic trip hazard removal like securing loose rugs, organizing cords, or moving furniture, permits are generally not required. However, if the hazard involves significant structural changes, such as altering load-bearing walls, major electrical rerouting, or extensive flooring replacement that impacts structural integrity, then permits from the local building department in Pacifica or Daly City may be necessary. City Dweller, LLC can help determine if your project requires permits and assist with the application process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits are usually not needed for minor fixes. For major structural or electrical changes in Pacifica or Daly City, permits may be required.
